item.description:

  • 日本語名: お兄ちゃん、右手の使用を禁止します！２
  • 英語名: Onii-chan, Migite no Shiyou o Kinshi Shimasu! 2

あらすじ

Hiroto lives with his four cute imoutos. One day, his father called him back home and unexpectedly introduced him to his new twin step-sisters. One of them is a famous idol, and the other is a popular cosplayer. He enjoys a happy life surrounded by six pretty imoutos fighting for his attention.

item.title: Onii-chan Teacher ~Himitsu no Jugyou o Kibou Shimasu!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Galette
  • 発売日: 2015-12-25
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (82 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お兄ちゃんティーチャー ～秘密の授業を希望します！～
  • 英語名: Onii-chan Teacher Himitsu no Jugyou o Kibou Shimasu!

别名

  • おにティ

あらすじ

Shuugo grew up in a remote snowy area. He left his village to chase his dream of becoming a teacher and got a job at a city in the same prefecture. However, he was temporarily assigned as the lone teacher and administrator of the branch school until the snow melted in spring. There were only four students at the school: Kanae, Ruri, Ai and Tsubomi. They were all his imoutos and they all loved him very much. So begins his strange dual life as their teacher during the day and as their older brother at night.

item.title: Onii-chan, Migite no Shiyou o Kinshi Shimasu!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Galette
  • 発売日: 2014-09-26
  • スコア: 7.15/10 (157 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お兄ちゃん、右手の使用を禁止します！
  • 英語名: Onii-chan, Migite no Shiyou o Kinshi Shimasu!

别名

  • おに禁

あらすじ

Hiroto is a student who lives by himself. One day, he injured his right hand while protecting his younger sisters. Luckily it was not serious, but they mistakenly thought it was the opposite?! He was excused from school until it healed, and his imoutos forbade him from using it. Of course, it would be quite inconvenient, so they suggested that they will always be by his side, as his ‘right hand’. From that day on, everything that he did with his right hand was left to his younger sisters: eating, taking a bath, doing groceries, going to the washroom, masturbating… “Leave everything to us, onii-chan!”

item.title: Onii-chan Sharing
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Galette
  • 発売日: 2013-09-27
  • スコア: 7.19/10 (168 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お兄ちゃんシェアリング
  • 英語名: Onii-chan Sharing

别名

  • Oniishare

あらすじ

Seseri, Futaba, Chiko and Yuu are four very close childhood friends who share everything amongst themselves. Kazuki has been with them since they were young and loved them all like they were his younger sisters (including his real younger sister Seseri). One day, they wondered who’s big brother (Onii-chan) he is. Of course, everyone’s big brother! As such, he’s free to return to any of their homes and spend the night under the same roof as them. Wouldn’t you like to experience all these various daily lives with your younger sisters?
